Subject: Technical deep dive — Acme Health Tech (ML/Infra session)

Hi Asha,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — great to learn more about the Acme Health Tech roadmap and the model/infra constraints you mentioned. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Goal: 60–90 min technical deep dive with your ML + infrastructure leads to validate integration patterns, performance expectations, and data flows.
- Who we suggest from Acme: ML lead (Rajiv), infra/SRE who owns deployment/networking.
- Who we will bring: Marissa (solutions/ML infra), Dylan (serving/runtime lead) + me to coordinate.

Proposed time windows (all PT):
- Wed 2027-06-17, 10:00–11:30
- Thu 2027-06-18, 13:00–14:30
- Fri 2027-06-19, 09:00–10:30

Proposed agenda (high level — attached as PDF):
1) 5–10m intros & objectives
2) 20–30m architecture review (current model sizes, inference pattern, data residency)
3) 20–30m runtime/ops deep dive (latency targets, batching, KV cache, quantization options)
4) 15–20m integration checklist & next steps (networking, auth, SLA expectations)

Can you please confirm who from your side will join and which of the time windows works best? If none of those work, send a couple of alternatives and we’ll adjust.

I attached a short proposed agenda and a prep checklist for your ML/infra team to review. Also here’s my Calendly if that’s easier: https://calendly.com/camila-reyes/60min

Thanks — Camila

--
Camila Reyes

For prep, it would be helpful if Rajiv can share the following before the session:
- Typical model family and sizes (e.g., LLM name and parameter count OR custom model quantization)
- Typical concurrent requests / p95 latency targets
- Tokenization / average input lengths and expected output lengths
- Any compliance/networking constraints (VPC, egress rules, data residency)

I attached a 1-page prep checklist that we use to tailor the deep dive. If you can drop answers into the shared doc (link below) or send them over, we’ll tailor the demo and have suggested config (+ quantization/batching) ready.
